role: Independent judge J1 (WL98, design-only): defensibility and falsifiability
summary:
I read all four designs (DR, D1, D2, D3) and all four critiques (X1–X4), and checked the key facts in code and canon myself: the model86.py:83-104 generator inputs, Architecture.md:20/25/56/70, the RESEARCH_CENTRIC_TOPIC novelty rule, the human decision of 2026-11-13 that made ECRO central, and the WL97 COORD sections 1, 2 and 8.

Finding accepted after checking: every designer and critic concludes that scene86/GM1, with only planar and convex objects and pointwise ER, has no rigid-reusable learned transport object. I correct the reason. The deciding factor is not 'information beyond explicit queries': D1's Proposition I holds equally for media and for rigid-body self-transport. It is whether the amortised quantity stays invariant under the edit, so that computed STATE can be reused and not only the weights (Architecture.md:56). In GM1 only rule reuse is possible. On the engineered kernel basis, regenerating the learned state for each edit costs as much as or more than the explicit work it replaces (0.85–0.97, D3/X3 arithmetic).

The coordinator's FLS fails as a learned candidate on four counts: its learned part is ER × incident-deposit lobe compression; K ≤ 8 separable lobes cannot hold the CK2 point-light glint; it gives up linearity; and its delivery is explicit. Its upgraded twin, ELT with image-source shear, is kept as an explicit comparator. ECRO-FC fails as a candidate because its factors are coupled to current visibility. It is useful only as factorised H1/H2 diagnostic arms.

Primary: RB-DTO-C, D3's RB-DTO corrected with the critics' fixes. The fixes are: linear per-sample pushforward with no nonlinear per-patch reduction; an exact escape budget; sender-side delivery of sharp exits; whole-body fallback; cached explicit self-visibility shared with the twin; and the strongest twins, namely sender-side chain tracing and compressed precomputed per-body transfer. It is conditional on a canon refinement (HA). Alternative: XQT, conditional on HD-1 (HB). It has the cheapest, cleanest learned-vs-twin gate and is predicted to stop there. If HB is 'no', the alternative is none within GM1, and LIEM-S is the GM2 reserve.

Proposed verdict: DESIGN_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW. Conversion rule: if HA is rejected, HB is 'no' and GM2 stays closed, the verdict becomes NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE, scoped. Every survivor is predicted more likely to stop at a learning-free Stage-1 gate than to reach training.

primary:
RB-DTO-C: D3's Rigid-Body Directional Transfer Operator, corrected. One shared compiler maps a rigid body's mesh and ER descriptors to latents once. An apply network maps each incident sample to a passive, linear pushforward: the body's exit measure after at least one self-hit, N_b = (I − K_b C_self)^-1 K_b − K_b. The first event stays exact ER.

Required corrections: no nonlinear per-patch mixture reduction; an exact escape budget E_esc computed against the cached explicit self-relation and charged to the method; sharp exits delivered sender-side into current-geometry C_ext; whole-body explicit fallback on any intrusion into the self-path region; self-visibility explicit and cached, shared with the twin; and comparison against the strongest twins (explicit sweeps on the cached rigid self-relation with sender-side chain tracing, and compressed precomputed per-body transfer) and measured prior art (OSF/TransGI as Native Reuse, or explicitly UNMEASURED).

Conditional on human decision HA (certified rigid self-coupling) and on a GM1 workload extension with non-convex glossy rigid bodies, including an adversarial workload. It is the only candidate whose learned output is sharp, nonlocal and reusable as state under rigid edits. It is predicted more likely to stop at its learning-free Stage-1 gates (U0 anatomy, oracle vs compressed twin) than to reach training.
alternative:
XQT (D1), conditional on HD-1 (HB: is a learned estimator over explicit visibility samples admissible as learned transport?). It is canon-compliant, sits in GM1 on existing workloads and machinery, and is independent of RB-DTO-C in regime, ownership, reuse type and failure mode.

Required corrections: passivity stated as in-expectation, with a per-draw test; point-level visibility consistency; a field-independent per-geometry oracle; the strongest twins (edge-aware kernel, exact-re-evaluation spatial reuse, sender-side deposition, MIS); and a utility ceiling defined as U(1 draw + XQT) vs U(m pooled draws). It is predicted to stop at its learning-free gate.

If HB is 'no', the alternative is NONE within GM1. LIEM-S is the GM2 reserve only if the owner opens GM2 (X2 and X4 preferred LIEM-S as the alternative).
best_falsification_plan:
PRINCIPLE: learning-free gates first. Training runs only when a learning-free result makes it informative. Every stop is final for the batch. All thresholds are [HUM].

STAGE 0 (learning-free, mandatory): freeze, instruments and admission.
(a) Reference instruments: exact-direction probes qualified against the deterministic exact-ER first-flight quadrature and the existing binned tallies; cos-weighted cell tallies; incident flux per receiver cell; event-count and self-path tags; depth matched to every arm or the truncation residual reported; independent reference halves. Fail -> STOPPED_REFERENCE_UNQUALIFIED.
(b) Workloads, admitted on geometry-only or learning-free rules before any arm output exists.
- GM1 Track G: W-G2 grazing, admitted on the delivered sharp difference at glint-core AND tail receivers; W-N non-grazing; W-H held-out with a declared distribution shift; CK2 diagnostic only, excluded from gate arithmetic, and needing a T1 reference if used.
- Track B (only if HA): grazing cavity, non-grazing, held-out body class and light class, and an adversarial workload.
- Rigid edits with path-traced references at T0 and T1: an occluder that enables or blocks a sharp path; motion of a sharp object or body; a certificate-violation control.
- Change SNR checked on an independent partition. Fail -> STOPPED_UNQUALIFIED_WORKLOAD.
(c) Train/validation/test split by family, class and margins, applied to every trained arm.
(d) Unified GPU-busy timeline plus wall; compile and recompile counts; an engineered explicit comparator; a full-scale probe of every stage.

STAGE 1 (learning-free decomposition).
1a H2-carrier: floors for SA 4x16, FC 4x16, FC 8x32, adaptive FC, pooled exact per-ray and ELT-shear, per receiver class, fitted on half A and scored on half B.
1b H2-operator / H1 prerequisite: the delivery-optimal patch x 64 operator vs the reference, and a light-independent rank 16/48/64 operator under the declared weightings, plus a light-conditioned control.
1c H3 ceiling: role-specific ceilings (resolvent-only; full resident operator; full + per-edit generator) on kernel and wall bases, N {1.3k, 5k, 11k}, lights {1, 4, 16}, quality-matched via spp ladders at tiers away from the floors, with draw pooling. If no role that does not learn C reaches U_min on >= 2 workloads -> H3 SUPPORTED at ceiling for the ECRO lineage.
1d XQT (if HB): field-independent oracle kernel vs the strongest twins, with CRN, >= 16 draws, sharp ROI and equal cost. STOP if the margin < m_req or the U ratio is below threshold.
1e RB-DTO-C (if HA):
- U0 against Twin 1 (cached self-relation + sender-side chain tracing). STOP_NO_HEADROOM if U0 < U_min.
- Per-body oracle floor vs Twin 2 (compressed precomputed transfer) at matched memory and apply time. STOP_NO_LEARNING_HEADROOM if within paired noise.
- Collision-pair test if any self-visibility is inferred.

STAGE 2 (H1 attribution of ECRO; only if 1b shows a feasible class floor, or HD requests it).
- Pilot: ECRO-R with >= 5 fresh seeds, to estimate the seed SD and set n.
- Arms: ECRO-COV (coverage only), ECRO-SUP (physical S1 target only, never M64), ECRO-FC (carrier only, no passivity, matched rays per bin); frozen checkpoints as the reference point.
- Readings: opt vs allocation vs operator capacity vs carrier.

STAGE 3 (train survivors only).
- RB-DTO-C arms: B3 natural coverage; B4 designed impulse measure with a grazing quota; B5 per-asset fit.
- XQT, if it survived 1d.
- Contract tests before any evaluation: zero, superposition, non-negativity, passivity per draw and in expectation, composed spectral radius with a valid estimator, rigid equivariance, convex N_b = 0, path-tag disjointness, certificate, furnace, reciprocity. Fail -> STOPPED_CONTRACT.
- Exposure-bias metric.
- H-L STOP if learned <= twin within paired noise on >= 2 workloads.

STAGE 4: fixed-weight T0->T1 with no retraining.
- Arms: all survivors + STALE + quality-matched explicit comparators.
- Evidence: representation, image, leakage/ghosting, extra T1-T0 error, selective = full.
- External baselines: Native Reuse measured or UNMEASURED; Neural Full Recompute only where a representation is invalidated.

STAGE 5: economics.
- Time-to-tier from the edit, with progressive draw pooling allowed to explicit arms.
- Steady frame, inference, relation recompute, certificate cost, memory and precompute.
- U vs the quality-matched explicit comparator. A positive claim needs 2 workloads including the held-out one.

SHARING: only the ECRO arms share a generator and budget (COV changes the measure as the treatment). XQT and its twin share inputs and draws. RB-DTO B2/B3/B4/B5 and Twin 2 share the exit samples. Track G and Track B share only the renderer, metrics, statistics and timing.

STATISTICS: CRN pairing; block bootstrap; independent reference halves; seed as a random effect with n from the pilot; >= 16 draws; never an L1 noise floor as a tolerance; heavy-tail guards; fit/score split halves; all rules frozen before results.
grafts: D1: flux-exact projected-disk carrier rules M1-M3 (flux per projected-measure cell; never tabulate sharp outgoing radiance; emit/read at the exact point); event-count ownership partition; dependency certificate tested as selective = full; contract tests T1-T10; W-G2 admission on the delivered sharp difference at glint-core and tail receivers; collision-pair information test (S1-d)

D2: principles P1-P8; designed impulse coverage measure as a treatment (mu_D vs mu_S), with a grazing quota, applied to RB-DTO-C incident samples; event-likelihood supervision on unbiased physical samples; ECRO-R fresh-seed arm as the seed pilot; G0 stop rule (no role that does not learn C reaches U_min -> no ECRO-lineage training for architecture purposes); G1 class floors

verdict_rationale:
A primary (RB-DTO-C) and an independent alternative (XQT) have complete, corrected contracts, and each depends on one named human decision (HA, HB). The merged plan keeps the hypotheses apart:
- H1: factorised ECRO arms, read against weighting-matched class floors.
- H2: carrier floors and operator-class floors with a rank axis.
- H3: role-specific learning-free ceilings, then a quality-matched fixed-weight T0->T1 test.
- Learned vs twin: learning-free oracle-vs-strongest-twin gates BEFORE any training.
CK2 stays diagnostic and M64 stays out of truth.

The verdict is design-ready because every remaining branch is decided either by a named human decision or by a cheap learning-free gate. It is not an expectation of success: each survivor is predicted more likely to stop at Stage 1 than to reach training.

Conversion rule: if the owner rejects HA, answers HB 'no' and keeps GM2 closed, the correct verdict is NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE, scoped to scene86/GM1 under the current canon. All three designers and four critics converge on that reading for planar/convex GM1. It is not a class-level falsification of reusable learned transport (WL97 P0-5b). Not adoption, not experiment approval.

summary:
I read all eight WL98 design and critique files. I checked the canon (Architecture.md:20,25; the roadmap GM1/GM2 rows; the 2026-11-13 human decision that ECRO is the central GM1 base) and the ECRO generator code (model86.py:83-104). I ran one numpy scratch (experiments/wl98_calc/J2/rb_twin_split.py -> results/wl98_calc/J2/rb_twin_split.json).

Central finding, a pincer covering the whole hypothesis [PRED, merging D1 Proposition I, D2 section 3, D3 section 2.5 and my scratch]:
(a) Transport that is not rigid-invariant (all inter-body transport in the planar/convex scene86/GM1 family) cannot keep learned state across an edit. Only the weights are reused, and the state must be regenerated per edit. That regeneration competes with cheap explicit evaluation: the resolvent ceiling is 1.02-1.04, and on the kernel basis the per-edit generator costs at least as much as the explicit work it replaces.
(b) Transport that is rigid-invariant (body self-transport, intrinsic media) has reusable learned state. But a learning-free per-asset precomputed table of the same transport (TwinP or Twin-T) is equally reusable and no more expensive at edit time. The edit-time lever therefore belongs to precomputation, not to learning. What is learning-specific is static: memory (about 2 MB vs 35-180 MB per asset at alpha 0.03, placeholder constants), seconds of one-off precompute, and generalisation to unseen assets.
So a geometry-edit advantage attributable to learning is structurally unlikely in any workload buildable now, and the plan must credit utility to precomputation (U_pre) and to learning (U_learn) separately.

The coordinator's pair, FLS and ECRO-FC, should not go forward; all three designers and all four critics agree. FLS is ER compression plus mixture reduction with explicit cubature delivery, and needs about 10 lobes per element at CK2 grazing. ECRO-FC changes three treatments at once, conditions on the whole scene and re-learns ER.

Ranking: RB-DTO-E 4.5 > LIEM-S 4.0 > ECRO lineage 2.5 (diagnostic is mandatory) = XQT 2.5 > FLS 2.0 > LLT 1.5 > LER-Delta 1.0.

Primary is RB-DTO-E, my canon-compatible reformulation of D3's RB-DTO. The learned rigid-body sharp self-transport operator consumes cached explicit self-relation records validated by the canonical dirty test, so C keeps ownership of C_self. Independent alternative is LIEM-S (D2): canonical ownership but GM2 scope, sharpness exact rather than learned, prior art Vicini 2019, and a medium reference that is not yet qualified.

I disagree with X1, X2 and X4 on one point: ECRO's Ft is an explicit visibility input, not learned visibility. The fatal defects are whole-scene conditioning, full per-edit regeneration and re-learning ER.

Proposed verdict: DESIGN_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW, conditional on the lineage, scope, workload and comparator decisions. The dissent to preserve is that under the current canon and the current GM1 workload family alone the reading is NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE. I predict the most likely outcome is a stop at the learning-free stage.

primary:
RB-DTO-E (reformulated from D3 RB-DTO). A shared, learned, continuous-lobe operator for the sharp multi-bounce self-transport of a rigid non-convex body, reused unchanged under that body's rigid motion.

It consumes the body's cached explicit self-relation records, traced once in the body frame and validated after each edit by the canonical dirty test, plus exact ER. So C keeps ownership of C_self, and the learned part owns only the amortised composition (K o C_self)^j. Its output is a passive, measure-defined exit pushforward.

D3's original form, with implicit learned self-visibility under a certificate, needs a refinement of Architecture section 2 [HUM HD-C]. Choosing either form also needs HD-L, because the 2026-11-13 decision asks for an ECRO-lineage hypothesis, and HD-W (a GM1 workload extension with non-convex glossy bodies).

The low prior is stated: the edit-time lever is shared with a learning-free precomputed transfer (TwinP), and the most likely outcome is a learning-free stop at S1-B. Under the current canon combined with the current scene86/GM1 workload family: none.
best_falsification_plan:
One plan, learning-free first. Everything is frozen before its inputs exist; each stop is final; no rescue; every number is [HUM].

HYPOTHESES
- H1 split three ways: opt (learned arm vs operator-class floor at the same incidence weighting), alloc (floor movement with weighting), cov (natural vs designed coverage).
- H2 split two ways: carrier floor ladder vs operator-class floor over a rank axis, e.g. r in {16, 48, 64}.
- H3: quality-matched U at T1 with fixed weights. Credit is split: U_pre = U(TwinP)/U(per-update explicit) goes to precomputation; U_learn = U(learned)/U(TwinP) goes to learning. A learned H3 refutation needs U_learn >= U_min on 2 evidence workloads.
- H-L: learned-family oracle restricted to the learned model's own information and linearity, vs the strongest learning-free twin.

S0 FREEZE / INSTRUMENTS / WORKLOADS / FRONTIER (learning-free, shared)
- S0a. Qualify new reference tallies: exact-direction probes, cos-weighted cells, incident flux per cell, self/inter-body/event/last-sender path tags, deeper kmax with truncation residual. Validate against deterministic exact-ER quadrature and existing field_src overlaps, with independent halves. Never M64. Stop: STOPPED_REFERENCE_UNQUALIFIED.
- S0b. Admit workloads by geometry/SNR rules before any arm output.
  - GM1 Track G: W-G2 grazing sharp, admitted on delivered sharp share with glint-core and tail receivers; W-N non-grazing; W-H distribution-shifted held-out, radiance uninspected; CK2 diagnostic only with a new T1 reference and excluded from all gate arithmetic.
  - Track B (if HD-L/HD-W): W-graze-B, W-broad-B, W-held-B (unseen body class and light class), W-adv-B (adversarial: moderate self-transport, frequent intrusion).
  - Edits: rigid body move, occluder move, record-dirtying intrusion. Path-traced T0 and T1 references everywhere. No T1 data in training or selection. Stop: STOPPED_UNQUALIFIED_WORKLOAD.
- S0c. Engineered explicit frontier and cost anatomy.
  - Arms: R0/EXP, C3UR, C3URX1 at 1-16 pooled draws, sender-side deposition, MIS of gather + deposition, FC 4x16 / 8x32 / adaptive, ELT with image-source shear, Track B Twin 1 (quality-matched sender-side chain tracing per update) and TwinP (precomputed per-body lobe/compressed transfer).
  - Conventions: unified kernel basis plus wall; compile and cache-miss accounting; draw-pooling convention (time-to-tier from the edit, progressive explicit draws allowed); tiers away from all floors with a NOT-REACHED rule; 1/4/16 lights; N in {1.27k, ~5k, ~11k}.

S1 LEARNING-FREE DECISIONS
- S1-G (ECRO lineage): carrier floors (SA 4x16, FC 4x16, FC 8x32, adaptive, exact per-ray) and non-negative light-independent operator floors over the rank axis at declared weightings, fit on reference half A and scored on half B, plus role ceilings at zero and at measured learned cost vs S0c. GATE G: if no role reaches U_min at matched quality on >= 2 workloads, H3 is supported at ceiling for the lineage on GM1, and training runs only by HD-T.
- S1-B (RB-DTO-E): U0 = L/(L - A_intra) with quality-matched Twin 1; per-body lobe-family oracle floor (split halves); TwinP at matched memory; oracle-vs-TwinP gap; collision-pair test on any inference beyond records. STOP if U0 < U_min, or the floor fails on W-graze-B, or the gap is within paired noise on both the fidelity and memory axes.
- S1-I (LIEM-S, only if HD-S): I0.1 reference, I0.2 headroom with measured U0, I0.3 twins, I1 floors.

S2 TRAINING (survivors only)
- S2a. Seed pilot: >= 5 seeds of the cheapest arm; seed SD on each gate metric; n computed for the declared minimum effect (3 seeds detect only >= 2.4x-11.6x).
- S2b. ECRO factorised arms: ECRO-R, ECRO-COV (coverage only), ECRO-SUP (physical S1 target only), ECRO-FCc (carrier only, matched state rays per bin), optional ECRO-LOC (local-frame, bounded receptive field). All read against weighting-matched floors.
- S2c. RB-DTO-E: shared model on natural vs designed grazing coverage, a per-body fitted arm, and an exposure-bias metric (reference vs pipeline incidence per sweep). Contract tests run before evaluation (measure, per-realisation passivity, superposition, rigid equivariance, convex N_b == 0, path-tag disjointness, furnace, planar-mirror image-source exactness); a failure is STOPPED_CONTRACT.

S3 T0 -> T1, FIXED WEIGHTS
- Arms: survivors, quality-matched frontier points, TwinP, STALE.
- Measures: changed-region fidelity, signed-change slope/correlation, leakage/ghosting outside predicted support, extra T1 - T0 error, selective = full.

S4 SYSTEMS
- Update critical path, steady frame including lobe-query overhead, inference, relation recompute and dirty test, memory, compile/training as one-off costs, the U_pre/U_learn split.
- Native Reuse of an object-level neural asset measured, or UNMEASURED with a reason. Neural Full Recompute only if actually invalidated. PT reported as reference cost only.

STATISTICS
- Paired common random numbers; block bootstrap; reference noise from independent halves; seed as a random effect; >= 16 draws with the deployed distribution; never an L1 noise floor as tolerance; heavy-tail guards; two-workload confirmation; CK2 never a gate input; dev on non-evidence inputs.

SHARING
- ECRO arms share the generator and budget (COV is the measure treatment).
- RB-DTO-E arms share the body generator and exit samples; TwinP is built from the same samples.
- Tracks G, B and I share only the renderer, metrics, statistics and conventions.

Synthetic contract tests and real scenes are both required: contracts give exact answers and expose compensation; real scenes give coverage, composition, readout, edit response and economics.

verdict_rationale:
What is ready:
- A primary, RB-DTO-E, with a complete contract once the critics' corrections are carried in. It is the only candidate whose success would answer GM1's own question: learned sharp multi-bounce state reused after rigid edits.
- An independent alternative, LIEM-S, also with a complete contract after the critics' corrections. Its ownership is canonical.
- A merged plan that separates H1, H2 and H3 with factorised arms and a weighting-matched rank axis, and splits utility credit between precomputation and learning. Its first decisive stage is learning-free and can close every line, ECRO lineage included, before any training.

Why the verdict is for human review:
- Both candidates need human decisions (lineage, scope, workload, comparator definition) before they are candidates at all.
- Neither is kept alive by force: each passes the brief's six unsuitability criteria on its own corrected contract.

The dissent stands. Under the current canon and the current GM1 workload family alone, the correct reading is NO_DEFENSIBLE_CANDIDATE. If the owner declines HD-L, HD-W and HD-S, that becomes the batch verdict.

[PRED] A geometry-edit advantage attributable to learning is unlikely in any workload buildable now, because of the pincer: state that is not rigid-invariant must be regenerated, and rigid-invariant transport is equally served by precomputed tables. The experiment deserves its learning-free stage; training is warranted only if that stage finds a matched-quality regime and an oracle-vs-strongest-twin gap. This verdict is not adoption and not experiment approval.
